title: A pragmatic reassessment of HTTP aware features for web attack detection on CIC-IDS2017 and CSIC 2010
description: Code and aggregated results of the study "A pragmatic reassessment of HTTP aware features for web attack detection on CIC-IDS2017 and CSIC 2010", a follow on study of the SentinelSphere platform carried out under the Horizon Europe project ResilMesh, Grant Agreement No. 101119681. The repository holds the analysis code, the result tables and the figures of the Open Research Europe article. Third party datasets and benchmark items are not included.
